content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

John Rodriguez (E049) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two notes:
- Note 1 (HR?): role Analyst, full-time employee. Recommends write (full-time up to write).
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, contractor, basic security training. Recommends read (contractors can have read or write with advanced training; basic training => max read).

The two notes conflict on employment type. Note 1 says full-time, note 2 says contractor and explicitly says security record takes precedence.

As Approver, I need to make the final decision. The security note says the security DB shows contractor with basic training, taking precedence. So employment type contractor, basic training. Contractors: read, or write only with advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => maximum is read.

Requested level: write. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant maximum = read.

So grant read.

Let me submit decision: read, with reasoning citing contractor + basic training, max read, grant read.
